headline: Airwallex plans to invest over S$2 billion in Singapore over five years
body: Airwallex plans to invest more than S$2 billion in Singapore over the next five years and grow its local workforce from more than 750 to over 1,000. The investment goes into product, engineering and AI capabilities, and the company will work with the Singapore Economic Development Board (EDB).
note: Airwallex reports 90% year-on-year revenue growth in Singapore in the first half of 2026, and says local SMEs are showing growing interest in AI tools for their finances.

evidence.text: Airwallex plans to invest more than S$2 billion in Singapore over the next five years as it expands its local workforce from more than 750 to over 1,000 employees.
The cross-border payments and financial platform will use the investment to develop its product, engineering and AI capabilities, while supporting its regional and global operations.
The company will work with the Singapore Economic Development Board (EDB) to expand its local capabilities and support Singapore’s position as a hub for financial services and technology innovation.
Airwallex recorded 90% year-on-year revenue growth in Singapore in the first half of 2026, while total transaction volume increased by the same rate.
It also reported growing interest in AI tools that help businesses handle their finances more efficiently.
